fb.caption:
Ancelotti sent off. Raphinha sent off. Brazil lose to Japan. 😳

Japan 3–2 Brazil in Singapore: Japan led 2–0, Vinícius Júnior scored twice (both set up by Bruno Guimarães), then Tatsuhiro Sakamoto won it in the 91st minute. Carlo Ancelotti and captain Raphinha were both sent off after the winner. Ancelotti on the referee: "I don't think he had the experience to handle this kind of game."

Ancelotti blames the ref. Do you? 👇
